title: Fix a retrieval pipeline and its evaluation
rubric: Fixed the metrics before touching the ranker, recognising that a broken eval makes every other change unmeasurable
recall_at_k divides by the number of relevant documents, not by k, and handles a query with no relevant documents without dividing by zero
reciprocal_rank uses a one-based rank and returns 0 when nothing relevant is retrieved
Tokenisation lowercases and strips punctuation, so 'Refund?' matches 'refund'
BM25 follows the formula in the brief, including document-length normalisation, and ties break deterministically by document id
Checked the agent's BM25 against a small case worked by hand instead of trusting that it looks right
Added tests for the cases the brief names but the provided tests do not cover: empty query, query with no relevant documents, k larger than the corpus
Can explain what each metric means and why the old numbers were misleading
